name: asia-pacific-news-digest
description: Asia-Pacific news digest from major outlets across East Asia, South Asia, Southeast Asia, and Oceania

steps.name: fetch-east-asia
steps.prompt:
Fetch East Asian news:

🇯🇵 Japan:
- Japan Times: https://www.japantimes.co.jp/feed/
- NHK World (check: https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/)

🇨🇳 China:
- CGTN: https://www.cgtn.com/subscribe/rss.xml
- China Daily: http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/rss/world_news.xml

🇰🇷 South Korea:
- Korea Herald: http://www.koreaherald.com/rss/020000000000.xml

🇹🇼 Taiwan:
- Taipei Times: https://www.taipeitimes.com/rss/

Extract top 3-5 recent stories per source. Include headline, brief summary, and source. Return structured list.

steps.name: fetch-south-asia
steps.prompt:
Fetch South Asian news:

🇮🇳 India:
- Times of India: https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/rssfeedstopstories.cms
- The Hindu: https://www.thehindu.com/news/?service=rss
- NDTV: https://feeds.feedburner.com/ndtvnews-latest

🇵🇰 Pakistan:
- Dawn: https://www.dawn.com/feeds/top-stories

🇧🇩 Bangladesh:
- Dhaka Tribune: https://www.dhakatribune.com/feed

🇱🇰 Sri Lanka:
- News First: https://www.newsfirst.lk/feed/

Extract top 3 recent stories per country. Return structured list with country flags.

steps.name: fetch-southeast-asia
steps.prompt:
Fetch Southeast Asian news:

🇸🇬 Singapore:
- Channel NewsAsia: https://www.channelnewsasia.com/api/v1/rss-outbound-feed?_format=xml

🇹🇭 Thailand:
- Bangkok Post: https://www.bangkokpost.com/rss/data/topstories.xml

🇮🇩 Indonesia:
- Jakarta Post: https://www.thejakartapost.com/feed/

🇵🇭 Philippines:
- Philippine Daily Inquirer: https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/feed

🇻🇳 Vietnam:
- Vietnam News: https://vietnamnews.vn/rss/

🇲🇾 Malaysia:
- Malay Mail: https://www.malaymail.com/feed

Extract top 2-3 recent stories per country. Return structured list.

steps.name: fetch-oceania
steps.prompt:
Fetch Oceania news:

🇦🇺 Australia:
- ABC News: https://www.abc.net.au/news/feed/2942460/rss.xml
- Sydney Morning Herald: https://www.smh.com.au/rss/feed.xml

🇳🇿 New Zealand:
- NZ Herald: https://www.nzherald.co.nz/rss.xml

Extract top 3-4 recent stories per country. Return structured list.

steps.name: format-asia-pacific-digest
steps.prompt:
Create an Asia-Pacific news digest for Discord.

**EAST ASIA:**
{{east_asia}}

**SOUTH ASIA:**
{{south_asia}}

**SOUTHEAST ASIA:**
{{southeast_asia}}

**OCEANIA:**
{{oceania}}

FORMAT:
```
🌏 **Asia-Pacific News Digest — {date}**

**🇯🇵 Japan, 🇨🇳 China, 🇰🇷 South Korea, 🇹🇼 Taiwan**
• [Headline] — Summary (Country flag)
• [Headline] — Summary
• [Headline] — Summary

**🇮🇳 India, 🇵🇰 Pakistan, 🇧🇩 Bangladesh, South Asia**
• [Headline] — Summary
• [Headline] — Summary
• [Headline] — Summary

**🇸🇬 Singapore, 🇹🇭 Thailand, 🇮🇩 Indonesia, SE Asia**
• [Headline] — Summary
• [Headline] — Summary

**🇦🇺 Australia & 🇳🇿 New Zealand**
• [Headline] — Summary
• [Headline] — Summary

_Covering 15+ Asia-Pacific nations — OpenFang Asia-Pacific_
```

Focus on regionally significant stories. Keep under 2000 characters. Include relevant country flags.
